name: Photon Capital Advisors Limited
about: Photon Capital Advisors Limited engages in the software services, information technology, and information technology enabled services in India. The company provides solution and consultancy on software designing, development, customization, implementation, maintenance, testing and benchmarking; AI-native and data driven businesses includes research, development, deployment and communication of artificial intelligence, machine learning and deep learning systems, autonomous decision ingines, intelligent automation solutions etc. It also provides platforms across artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, cloud computing, cybersecurity and data intelligence. The company was formerly known as Hifco Marwel Limited. Photon Capital Advisors Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
